name: Head Start at Home
description: Free support and education in your home for expectant parents and children birth to three, offered in Franklin, Hampshire and Western Hampden Counties.

requirements.text: Head Start at Home is for pregnant women, expectant parents, and children birth through three.

Your family may qualify if it has a low income, if your child is a foster child, if your family receives SSI, DTA Cash or SNAP, or if your family is staying with others temporarily or is without housing.

unknowns: Dollar amount of the low-income limit

first_step.title: Apply online or call the enrollment office
first_step.detail: Apply online at the Community Action pre-application or call the HS & ELP Enrollment Office at 413-387-1250.
